subject:
**** Request for Quotation – Tender Ref. GEM/2026/B/7103056 – 12V 75AH Lead‑Acid Batteries for Indian Navy Battery SITC Project  

**
draft_body:
**  

Dear Sir/Madam,  

Volks Energie, on behalf of the Indian Navy, hereby invites your esteemed organization to submit a formal quotation for the supply of the equipment detailed below, in accordance with the terms and conditions set out in this Request for Quotation (RFQ).  

---

### 1. Tender Details  

| **Tender Reference** | **Procuring Authority** | **Project Title** | **Delivery Timeline** |
|----------------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-----------------------|
| GEM/2026/B/7103056   | Indian Navy              | Battery SITC      | 60 days (from PO issuance) |

---

### 2. Itemised Bill of Quantities (BoQ) & Technical Requirements  

| **Item No.** | **Item Description**            | **Quantity** | **Unit** | **Technical Specification** | **Delivery Location** | **Required By** |
|--------------|--------------------------------|--------------|----------|------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| 1            | 12 V 75 AH Lead‑Acid Battery   | 100          | Nos      | Naval Spec                   | Uttara Kannada        | –               |

*All supplied batteries must fully comply with the “Naval Spec” technical standards and be accompanied by a complete technical compliance sheet.*

---

### 3. Information Required in Your Quotation  

Please provide the following details for each line item:  

1. **Unit Price** (exclusive of GST)  
2. **GST Breakdown** (rate and amount)  
3. **Total Amount** (unit price × quantity + GST)  
4. **Lead Time** (in weeks/days) from receipt of Purchase Order to delivery at the specified location  
5. **Technical Compliance Sheet** confirming adherence to the Naval Specification  
6. **Validity Period** of the quotation (minimum 90 days)  

---

### 4. Commercial & Delivery Constraints  

- **Delivery Timeline:** 60 days from the date of Purchase Order issuance.  
- **Payment Terms:** [NEEDS REVIEW: payment_terms]  

All quotations must be submitted in Indian Rupees (INR) and be signed by an authorized representative of your organization.

---

### 5. Submission Instructions  

- **Submission Deadline:** 15 September 2026, 17:00 IST (no later than 5 pm Indian Standard Time).  
- **Method of Submission:** Email the completed quotation (PDF format) to **procurement@volksenergie.in** with the subject line “RFQ – GEM/2026/B/7103056 – [Your Company Name]”.  
- **Contact for Clarifications:** Mr. Arjun Mehta, Senior Procurement Manager, +91‑98765 43210, arjun.mehta@volksenergie.in  

---

### 6. Confidentiality  

All information contained in this RFQ is confidential and intended solely for the addressed OEM partner. Disclosure to any third party without prior written consent from Volks Energie is prohibited.

---

We look forward to receiving your competitive quotation and anticipate a mutually beneficial partnership.  

Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.  

Yours sincerely,  

**[Your Name]**  
Head of Procurement & Supply Chain  
Volks Energie
